title: Security Deposits Good-Payment Refund Review
content:
A good-payment refund of a Security Deposits deposit is made when the deposit has been held long enough and the account's payment record is good.

## Ruling

1. **Records refunded.** Refunds are paid only from a deposit record in partially paid or held status.
2. **Time held.** A refund review may take place only after the tier's good-payment months, as full calendar months, have passed since the deposit was paid in full. The clock starts on the paid-in-full date shown on the deposit record. Calendar months are counted from the paid-in-full date to the same day number of the later month, falling back to the last day of that month when the day number does not exist. The review date must be not earlier than the date so reached; a review on that very date satisfies the rule.
3. **Payment record.** The payment record is good when, in the review window, the late payment charges are at most the tier's allowance, the returned payments at most the tier's allowance and the reconnections after nonpayment (reconnect fees billed) at most the tier's allowance. The review window is the tier's good-payment months as full calendar months ending on the review date, on the service account the deposit secures.
4. **What a good review pays.** A good review refunds the whole cash held together with interest accrued to the refund date, by the tier's default refund method, or by check when the member asks for a check and the refund is at least the tier's smallest check-on-request amount.
5. **Retired clause.** The clause providing that a review that is not good leaves the deposit held and that it is reviewed again monthly is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.
6. **Accounts not refunded.** A deposit on a disconnected-for-nonpayment or final-billed account is never refunded; it is applied instead.

The time held and the payment record are read from the cooperative's records — the deposit record's paid-in-full date and the service account's charges, payments and fees — not from the member's recollection.

## Boundary cases on the time held (hypothetical dates)

| Paid-in-full date | Good-payment months | Earliest review date | A review one day earlier |
|---|---|---|---|
| March 15, 2025 | 12 | March 15, 2026 | March 14, 2026 does not satisfy rule 2 |
| August 31, 2024 | 18 | February 28, 2026 (February has no 31st) | February 27, 2026 does not satisfy rule 2 |
| January 31, 2024 | 24 | January 31, 2026 | January 30, 2026 does not satisfy rule 2 |

## Payment record test on hypothetical counts, at the Residential Standard Deposit allowances of 2, 0 and 0

| Late charges | Returned payments | Reconnect fees | Record |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | 0 | 0 | good |
| 3 | 0 | 0 | not good |
| 0 | 1 | 0 | not good |
| 1 | 0 | 1 | not good |

superseded_clauses: A review that is not good leaves the deposit held; it is reviewed again monthly.
